Agarican, Aserubera CR 12

XP 19,200
LN Medium plant (fungus)
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +25
Aura stench (DC 25, 15 rounds)

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 17, flat-footed 20 (+6 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural)
hp 161 (17d8+85)
Fort +15, Ref +11, Will +11
Immune plant traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 1 slam +15 (1d6+3), 6 tentacles +15 (1d6+3 plus poison)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 12th; concentration +17)

Constant—speak with plants
At will—dancing lights, plant shape II
3/day—plant growth
1/day—transport via plants

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 22, Con 20, Int 19, Wis 23, Cha 15
Base Atk +12; CMB +18, CMD 34
Feats Cleave, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Great Cleave, Greater Trip, Improved Critical (tentacles), Improved Stench, Improved Trip, Power Attack
Skills Bluff +19, Intimidate +19, Knowledge (nature) +21, Perception +25, Sense Motive +22, Stealth +22
Languages Agaric, Common, Sylvan, Terran, Undercommon; limited telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Luminescent Lamella (Ex)

The arms of an aserubra’s cap glow with a soft light, fading to darkness towards the tips. This emits light as a candle, increasing to that of a torch when the aserubra is using any of its spell-like abilities.

Mutamorph (Ex)

Despite being a plant, an aserubra can be affected by polymorph effects.

Poison (Ex)

Slam—injury; save Fort DC 27; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d3 Int; cure 1 save. Save DC is Con-based.

Spore Savant (Ex)

An aserubra who has allowed themselves to be infected by a psibyl’s psychic spores may expend a daily use of their plant growth ability while the psibyl is using its witness power on them to cause the psychic spores to not be destroyed at the end of the ability. As a standard action, an aserubra may cast sending, targeting any creature within 1 mile infected with psychic spores from the same psibyl, though the infected creature may choose to make a new saving throw against the psychic spores instead of responding to the sending. The psibyl whose spores infect the aserubra and its contact is aware of the content of messages sent through the sending effect, and also has the option to restrict who an aserubra is able to contact with this ability to as many or few individuals as they choose.

ABOUT

Environment temperate forests or swamps
Organization solitary, pair, or band (1-3 and 3 times that number unintelligent plant creatures)
Treasure standard

Anyone who has seen the starfish-looking red cap of an aserubra and mistaken it for being not a threat has overlooked a powerful shapeshifting spellcaster. Admittedly, the stench of rotting meat surrounding it should tip anyone off to be cautious. In their natural forms, they have anywhere from two to four legs, depending on the individual, and each has a ring of long tendrils around the main column of its body that it twines together to form rough manipulators as needed.

Most people who encounter an aserubra never realize it though, as more often than not the creatures disguise themselves as other fungal creatures, frequently even other agaricians. Their presence helps ensure the prosperity of any given bloom, enriching the local plant life through their abilities and acting as a secondary layer of relays for the psychic spores of the sibyl they serve. Aserubras also function as field commanders, being intelligent enough to coordinate battlefield operations unsupervised yet capable of maintaining a more reliable strong connection to a controlling psibyl. An aserubra-led mission group will often include one to four amanites, up to two dozen bolites, and half that many hoplites. Those with a base of operations may have even brought a toxiphage for supply.
